# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P43](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0043), [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He has a broad, freckled countenance and a cheerful, foolish grin.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v2 c8 P15](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy and stolid, possessing a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is good-natured and a great worker, with no bad habits. Though he lacks courage in social situations, he is proud of his achievements and enjoys simple pleasures.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)_

## Goals

- To marry and establish a home on the upper farm  <sub>[v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. He drove his double-seated buggy to take Jane, Diana, and Anne to the Debating Club concert in Newbridge. Later, he took a liking to Anne Shirley and wished to marry her. Too shy to propose himself, he convinced his sister Jane to ask Anne on his behalf after his father promised him the upper farm. After Anne declined, he turned his affections toward Nettie Blewett, whom he eventually married, moving to the upper farm.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045), [v2 c2 P22](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0022), [v2 c2 P25](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0025)_
